name: Serving
description: Jesus came to serve. This deck turns faith into action with kind dares, quiet acts of service, and honest talk about what it really means to help.

cards.title: Not to Be Served
cards.prompt: Who is a leader you know who serves? Share what they do.
cards.body: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

cards.title: By Love Serve
cards.prompt: Finish the sentence: 'One way I can serve someone with love is...'
cards.body: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

cards.title: Let Your Light Shine
cards.prompt: Name a good deed someone did that made you think of God.
cards.body: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

cards.title: Use Your Gift
cards.prompt: Name a gift or skill you have and how it could help someone this week.
cards.body: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.

cards.title: Do Good
cards.prompt: Explain this verse to the group using only 5 words.
cards.body: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

cards.prompt: Who has served you in a way you'll never forget?
What's your favorite way to help: cooking, organizing, encouraging, fixing, or something else?
Why is serving harder than it sounds?
Who around you is often overlooked, and how could you show up for them?
Do you ever serve just to be noticed? How can you serve quietly instead?
What's one thing you could give up this month to help someone else?

cards.title: Secret Service
cards.prompt: Do one kind thing for someone today and don't tell them it was you.

cards.title: Helping Hand
cards.prompt: Offer to carry something or open a door for someone near you.

cards.title: Clean-Up Crew
cards.prompt: Volunteer right now to tidy up, stack chairs, or help with the next task in your space.

cards.title: Thank You Note
cards.prompt: Write a two-line thank-you to someone who serves you: a teacher, parent, leader, or driver.

cards.title: Free Hour
cards.prompt: Offer an hour of your time to help someone this week and tell the group who.

cards.title: Serve Scavenger Hunt
cards.prompt: Teams complete acts of kindness from a list: encourage a stranger, pick up litter, offer water, help carry bags.
cards.instruction: Stay safe, keep everyone in sight, and ask permission before taking any photos. Most acts wins.

cards.title: Compliment Circle
cards.prompt: Everyone writes a name on a card. Pass the cards around so each person writes one genuine strength. Read them aloud.
cards.instruction: Keep every comment kind and specific.

cards.title: Serve Brainstorm
cards.prompt: List as many ways to serve your community as you can. The best idea becomes the group's next project.
cards.instruction: Teams write ideas. The group votes for the best one.

cards.title: Kindness Charades
cards.prompt: Act out acts of kindness without talking. The team guesses.
Share a time someone served you and it changed how you saw God.
Tell about a time you served and received more than you gave.
Share a time you felt God ask you to help someone.
Tell about a servant leader who shaped your faith.
